{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-opw2ln",
      "toKey": "n-1ubp9xd",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "RHOB requested attendance because the local indication P-R dropped (event n-58uu1f) while upstream pressure remained stable, indicating a supply-side issue that required Utilities intervention.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If P-R had not dropped, RHOB would not have requested attendance.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; the request is a direct response to the observed pressure drop and supply complaint.","evidenceGap":"The exact timing of the 'air-low' report relative to the alarm trigger (10:00:32) remains slightly ambiguous, but the causal link between low pressure indication and attendance request is supported by shift log entries at 10:00 and 10:02."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-58uu1f",
      "toKey": "n-1e6bh8z",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The drop in P-R (event n-58uu1f) occurred while upstream pressure remained stable, suggesting the interruption originated downstream of P-U or within a distribution segment serving RHOB.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1","fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the interruption had occurred upstream of P-U, both P-R and P-U would have dropped simultaneously.",
      "competingExplanation":"An equipment failure at RHOB receiving header H-R could also cause a local drop without affecting P-U; however, this is less likely given the transient nature (restored by 10:07 AM) and lack of evidence for receiver-side fault.","evidenceGap":"No continuous waveform data or valve-state records exist to definitively rule out a localized equipment failure at H-R."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-2jmrrk",
      "toKey": "n-se46ow",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The pending maintenance acceptance signature (condition n-2jmrrk) implies the boundary was not formally released, creating conditions where an unrecorded service-routing change or undocumented valve state could create a unique hazard scenario without immediate procedural safeguards.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1","0ff450fe-49da-4c67-8b42-35a449fdad35c#1"],
      "claimIds": ["finding-h3ez7i", "finding-jmeezw"],
      "counterfactual":"If the boundary had been formally released with all changes documented, such a hazard scenario would likely have been mitigated or detected earlier.",
      "competingExplanation":"The pressure drop could be due to an upstream event unrelated to any unrecorded change; absence of evidence for an 'unrecorded' change does not prove its existence.","evidenceGap":"No record confirms whether a service-routing change occurred, nor if it was undocumented. The claim remains speculative without positive evidence."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1lq9li6",
      "toKey": "n-se46ow",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The area directory does not establish valve positions or pressure availability at any given time, enabling the possibility that an undocumented valve state contributed to the hazard scenario.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual":"If the directory had established valve positions, an undocumented change would have been detectable via record review.",
      "competingExplanation":"Even with a complete directory, physical changes could still occur without immediate recording; however, this gap reduces detection capability.","evidenceGap":"No evidence of whether any specific valve was in an unexpected state at the time."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-xuyu0f",
      "toKey": "n-se46ow",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The daily work briefing contained no valve-by-valve content, enabling crews to miss critical configuration details that could have prevented the hazard scenario.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual":"If the briefing had included valve-by-valve content, crews might have detected or avoided an unexpected configuration.",
      "competingExplanation":"Briefing gaps alone do not guarantee failure; other factors (e.g., equipment malfunction) could still cause the event.","evidenceGap":"No evidence of whether recent changes were briefed or if specific drawings were seen."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1rww984",
      "toKey": "n-se46ow",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "No documented confirmation of understanding regarding root cause assessment or response steps exists, enabling delayed recognition and inadequate response to the air interruption.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual":"If such documentation existed, it might have prompted earlier or more effective response actions.",
      "competingExplanation":"Documentation gaps do not necessarily cause delays; communication breakdowns could also contribute.","evidenceGap":"No evidence of whether informal understanding occurred despite lack of formal records."
    }
  ],
  "decision": {
    "summary": "The incident involved a transient instrument-air pressure loss at RHOB during maintenance preparation. Supported conditions include stable upstream pressure, local indication drop, and pending boundary acceptance. Unknown but plausible contributors include unrecorded service-routing changes or undocumented valve states enabled by incomplete documentation (area directory lacking real-time data, briefings without valve details). Competing explanations for the cause remain unresolved due to lack of continuous waveform data and valve-state records.",
    "evidenceUsed": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1", "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1", "da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1", "fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],
    "unknowns": ["Whether an unrecorded service-routing change occurred.", "Exact point of interruption (source vs distribution vs receiver).", "Valve states at the time."],
    "alternatives": ["Upstream event affecting RHOB segment only.", "Localized equipment failure at H-R with transient recovery."],
    "confidence": 0.65
  },"evidenceRequests":[
    "requestId-1","id\":\"claim-x9yg85\",\"kind\":\"source-passage\"},{\"requestId-2\",\"id\":\"structured-incident\",\"kind\":\"synthetic-evaluation-record\"}]"
  ]
}
